title: Step 20: traceless horizontal forces conformal blow-up
conclusion: Collar integral 2/m^3 << 1/(2m): interior/transition dominates int w. The conformal blow-up exp(Ar^2/2) in the base metric creates a tension: the eigenvalue equation -Delta_0 w = 2 exp(Ar^2/2) w localizes w near rods, but the area element exp(2phi) amplifies the interior, so the integral of w is not dominated by the collar.
key_new_insight: The traceless horizontal equation is NOT automatically satisfied in flat-base collar coordinates. It requires phi ~ A r^2 / 4, which changes the base geometry from flat to exponentially expanding. This was not tested in Step 19's corner matching, which only checked the vertical/trace equations.
open_question: Does the exponentially expanding base metric, required by the traceless equation, change the global eigenvalue or flux in a way that obstructs or permits the collapsing seed? The transition from collar to interior carries most of int w and must be analyzed.
